subject: Request: Temporary invoice batching in lieu of PO — TribePilot trial
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@tribepilot.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Temporary invoice batching in lieu of PO — TribePilot trial

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get TribePilot into the integration pilot next week. One quick operational ask from finance that will speed provisioning on our side: can TribePilot accept invoice batching (weekly consolidated invoice + net-30 payment) for the 90-day pilot instead of issuing a purchase order per subscription change?

Why we ask: our pilot involves frequent small adjustments (seat swaps, short-term connectors). Requiring a PO for every change creates a process bottleneck and delays getting test users live. For pilots we typically accept a short-term "no-PO" path when the vendor agrees to a few mitigations:

- Signed temporary invoice agreement (DocuSign) specifying net-30 and invoice granularity
- W-9 + vendor intake form completed
- Invoice batching file format (CSV) agreed — sample attached (invoice-schedule.csv)
- Early termination / chargeback clause for disputed line items

I've attached a draft temporary MSA excerpt (trial-MSA.pdf) and a sample invoice schedule. If TribePilot is OK, we'll route this to our procurement team for a fast-track approval (aiming to keep it within a week).

Can you please confirm by EOD whether TribePilot can accept these terms for the pilot? If helpful we can also schedule a short call with finance.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment(s): trial-MSA.pdf (stub), invoice-schedule.csv (stub)

From: Erin Shaw <erin.shaw@tribepilot.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alex Morgan <alex@tribepilot.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary invoice batching in lieu of PO — TribePilot trial

Jordan / Alex —

Thanks for outlining. Quick questions from TribePilot finance:

1) When you say "fast-track approval," what controls does Redwood require to accept invoice-only billing (e.g., credit checks, PO thresholds, insurance)?
2) Will Redwood accept consolidated weekly invoices that include multiple line items (pilot seats, connector usage, ad-hoc professional services) or do you need separate invoices per item?
3) Who at Redwood signs the temporary invoice agreement? We prefer to avoid anything that looks like a full MSA commitment for a 90-day pilot.

If you can provide a short checklist of required attachments and the exact CSV columns for invoice ingestion that would help us automate. Alex and I can review internally and get back by tomorrow.

-Erin
Erin Shaw
VP Finance, TribePilot
erin.shaw@tribepilot.com | +1 212-555-0173

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: TribePilot invoice batching request — internal approval path

Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick internal note on process and recommended mitigations if we pursue the temporary "no-PO" lane for TribePilot:

- Required docs we need before approving: vendor intake complete, W-9 on file, evidence of commercial general liability insurance (CGI), and the signed temporary invoice agreement (DocuSign).
- Risk worksheet: I've populated an initial assessment and mitigation items — see attached (no-po-risk-worksheet.xlsx). Key risks flagged: refund/dispute handling, onboarding charge visibility, and potential volume spikes outside forecast.
- Approval ladder: for pilots below $50k ARR during the trial we can approve via Procurement + Sales Ops signoff; any forecast > $50k needs Finance VP signoff.
- Suggested operational guardrails: weekly consolidated invoice only; 10-day dispute window; auto-suspend on unpaid invoices after 45 days to limit exposure.

If Jordan confirms the expected pilot spend and Marissa can confirm Sales Ops OK, I can route to Finance for the fast-track approval. Also recommend we include a short clause in the DocuSign temp agreement limiting liability to amounts invoiced during the 90-day period.

-David
David Kim
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com

Attachment(s): no-po-risk-worksheet.xlsx (stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary invoice batching in lieu of PO — TribePilot trial

Alex / Erin —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Per David's note, we're prepared to offer a short-term, limited scope invoice-only path for the 90-day pilot if TribePilot can complete the checklist below and sign the temporary invoice agreement (link included). This keeps legal exposure minimal and removes the need for a PO for pilot-level changes.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
- TribePilot provides: completed vendor intake + W-9, evidence of insurance, and the agreed CSV schema applied to a sample invoice (attachment: invoice-schedule.csv).
- Redwood provides: fast-track procurement review and Sales Ops confirmation for pilots under $50k ARR. Procurement will accept weekly consolidated invoices and issue payment net-30.
- Operational guardrails: 10-day dispute window after invoice receipt, suspension at 45 days unpaid, auto-reconciliation by Sales Ops.
- Legal: sign the temporary invoice agreement only (DocuSign): https://www.docusign.com/TempAgreement/TP-INV-2026-089

I've attached a short onboarding checklist (tribepilot-onboarding-checklist.docx) that maps exactly which fields we need on the invoice CSV and who signs which doc. If TribePilot can return the completed items and sign the DocuSign by next Wednesday (2026-08-25) we can complete vendor setup and enable the pilot environment the following week.

Please let me know if you want a 20-min alignment call (Finance + Procurement + Alex) — happy to set it.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment(s): tribepilot-onboarding-checklist.docx (stub)
